items.review_rationale: Read finite local freeness of an R-module on standard open covers of Spec(R), preserving localization, finite rank on each open and potentially varying rank across opens.

references.context: Family of principal Zariski open subsets of Spec(R) covering the full spectrum.

references.phrase: free module of finite rank over R_{f_i}
references.context: Localized module is isomorphic to a finite direct sum R_{f_i}^n, with n depending on the open.

references.phrase: rank allowed to vary by open set
references.disposition: Finite local freeness need not mean global constant rank or globally free module.

items.review_rationale: Read finite projective R-modules by finite generation plus projectivity, and the equivalent characterizations as finite free summands and finite locally free modules.

references.phrase: direct summand of R^n for finite n
references.context: Some R-module Q makes M⊕Q isomorphic to free R^n where n is finite.

references.phrase: equivalence of three finite projectivity criteria
references.disposition: All characterizations include finiteness in some form; ordinary projectivity alone allows infinite rank.

items.review_rationale: Read local freeness of an R-module on basic Zariski open cover, with module and ring localization and free modules of possibly infinite and variable rank.

references.phrase: cover of Spec(R) by standard opens D(f_i)
references.context: Every prime ideal fails to contain at least one f_i; basic opens form a cover.
Localized module admits a basis over the localized ring; rank need not be finite in this definition.

references.phrase: locally free need not be finite locally free
references.disposition: No finite-rank condition appears in the local freeness statement.
